cases.title: Preview a legacy migration through the real MCP
cases.prompt: I want to upgrade this legacy Astro Starwind project to V3, but this is a planning pass: do not run the generated migration command or change project files. Use the prepared real Starwind MCP (`pnpm mcp -- list` shows its tools) to inspect the project and obtain the appropriate migration guidance. Keep the migration interactive, then explain the exact command, safety prerequisites, and what must be reviewed afterward.

assertions.description: Calls the pinned newest published MCP server
Uses the dedicated MCP migration tool
Keeps migration interactive instead of authorizing overwrite
Reports the generated migration command
Reports the recoverable working-tree prerequisite
Calls out post-migration review beyond command success
Does not manually rewrite the legacy config
Does not run the generated migration command

cases.title: Discover and prepare a React Primitive install
cases.prompt: This React project needs an editable Combobox Primitive vendored into src/primitives. Use the prepared real Starwind MCP (`pnpm mcp -- list` shows its tools) to verify that the Primitive supports React and obtain the exact pnpm install command for that destination. This is an approval pass, so report the command but do not execute it or modify project files.

assertions.description: Calls the pinned newest published MCP server
Searches the React Primitive surface explicitly
Requests the exact vendored Primitive command

assertions.pattern: pnpm dlx starwind@latest primitives add combobox --yes --framework react --to src/primitives --package-manager pnpm
assertions.description: Reports the generated Primitive command intact
Does not edit config during the approval pass
Does not run the generated install command

cases.title: Distinguish free and paid Pro results
cases.prompt: Compare one current free hero block with one paid pricing block for this Astro project. Use the prepared real Starwind MCP (`pnpm mcp -- list` shows its tools), limiting each search to the requested plan. Do not install or configure anything. Tell me which command is ready now, which command must remain deferred, and the safe setup step required before the paid install.

assertions.description: Calls the pinned newest published MCP server
Searches free Astro results explicitly
Searches paid Astro results explicitly
Reports the free installCommand

assertions.pattern: npx starwind@latest add @starwind-pro/pricing-02 badge button card switch --yes
assertions.description: Preserves the paid deferredInstallCommand and dependencies
Reports the required Pro setup command
Names the safe license environment variable
Does not invent or expose a license secret
Does not configure Pro during comparison
